 p_test_string VARCHAR2(100);
 quote_in VARCHAR2(5) := '''';
 test_in_utb VARCHAR2(1);
 test_in_utrs VARCHAR2(1);
 p_edit_flag VARCHAR2(5) := 'E';
BEGIN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_units');
 last_record;
 IF :CTRL_UNITS.UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 :ctrl_units.unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :ctrl_units.coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_2.sel_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 --next_record;

 IF :ctrl_blk_2.group_test_id IS NULL THEN
 p_test_string := :ctrl_blk_4.test_string;
 ELSE
 p_test_string := '('
 || quote_in
 || :ctrl_blk_2.group_test_id
 || quote_in
 || ')';
 END IF;

 p_edit_flag := '('
 || quote_in
 || p_edit_flag
 || quote_in
 || ')';
 
 /* p_where_clause1:=' unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ' and ' || 'test_id in '||p_test_string||
 ' and (test_id,test_seq_no) not in (select test_id,test_seq_no from test_voids where unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in||
 ' and test_id in '||p_test_string|| ' and chapter_id='||quote_in||:GLOBAL.chapter_id||quote_in||')';
 
 */

 IF :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action IN ( 'VOID', 'SUPVOID' ) THEN 
 /* p_where_clause1:=' unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ' and ' || 'test_id in '||p_test_string||
 ' and result_status_1 is not null and not exists (select 1 from test_voids tv where tv.unit_id=utrs.unit_id '||
 ' and tv.test_id=utrs.test_id and tv.result_status_1=utrs.result_status_1 and tv.test_seq_no=utrs.test_seq_no '||
 ' and tv.insert_dats >= utrs.insert_dats and void_type not in '||p_edit_flag||')';
 */

 p_where_clause1 := ' unit_id='
 || quote_in
 || :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 || quote_in
 || ' and '
 || 'test_id in '
 || p_test_string
 || ' and result_status_1 is not null and cancel_flag is null and nvl(chapter_id , :GLOBAL.chapter_id ) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id '
 ;
 ELSE
 /* p_where_clause1:=' unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ' and ' || 'test_id in '||p_test_string||
 ' and not exists (select 1 from test_voids tv where tv.unit_id=utrs.unit_id '||
 ' and tv.test_id=utrs.test_id and tv.result_status_1=utrs.result_status_1 and tv.test_seq_no=utrs.test_seq_no '||
 ' and tv.insert_dats >= utrs.insert_dats and void_type not in '||p_edit_flag||')';
 */

 p_where_clause1 := ' unit_id='
 || quote_in
 || :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 || quote_in
 || ' and '
 || 'test_id in '
 || p_test_string
 || ' and cancel_flag is null and nvl(chapter_id , :GLOBAL.chapter_id ) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ';
 END IF; 
 
 
 

 --message('where:'||p_where_clause1);pause;

 set_block_property('UTRS', default_where, p_where_clause1);
 go_block('UTRS');
 clear_block;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 first_record;
 IF :utrs.test_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 test_in_utrs := 'Y';
 END IF;
 
 
 -- message('where='||get_block _property('UTRS',default_where));pause;

 IF :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action IN ( 'VOID', 'SUPVOID' ) THEN
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action = 'VOID' THEN 
 
 /* p_where_clause2:=' unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ' and ' || 'test_id in '||p_test_string||
 ' and result_status_1 is not null and not exists (select 1 from test_voids tv where tv.unit_id=unit_test_base.unit_id and '||
 ' tv.test_id=unit_test_base.test_id and tv.result_status_1=unit_test_base.result_status_1 and tv.test_seq_no=unit_test_base.test_seq_no '||
 ' and tv.insert_dats >= unit_test_base.insert_dats and void_type not in '||p_edit_flag||')';
 */

 p_where_clause2 := ' unit_id='
 || quote_in
 || :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 || quote_in
 || ' and '
 || 'test_id in '
 || p_test_string
 || ' and result_status_1 is not null and cancel_flag is null and result_dats is not null ';

 /* p_where_clause2:=' unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ' and ' || 'test_id in '||p_test_string||
 ' and not exists (select 1 from test_voids tv where tv.unit_id=unit_test_base.unit_id and '||
 ' tv.test_id=unit_test_base.test_id and tv.result_status_1=unit_test_base.result_status_1 and tv.test_seq_no=unit_test_base.test_seq_no '||
 ' and tv.insert_dats >= unit_test_base.insert_dats and void_type not in '||p_edit_flag||')';
 */
 p_where_clause2 := ' unit_id='
 || quote_in
 || :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 || quote_in
 || ' and '
 || 'test_id in '
 || p_test_string
 || ' and cancel_flag is null and result_dats is not null';
 END IF;

 set_block_property('UNIT_TEST_BASE', default_where, p_where_clause2);
 go_block('UNIT_TEST_BASE');
 
 --message('where2='||get_block_property('UNIT_TEST_BASE',default_where));pause;

 clear_block;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 first_record;
 IF :unit_test_base.test_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 test_in_utb := 'Y';
 END IF;
 
 --message('where2='||get_block_property('UNIT_TEST_BASE',default_where));pause;

 ELSE

 END IF;

 check_multiple_sequence(:ctrl_blk_2.sel_unit_id, p_navigate);
 --message('Navigate='||p_navigate);pause;

 IF p_navigate = 'UTRS' THEN
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := NULL;
 ELSIF p_navigate = 'UTB' THEN
 go_block('UNIT_TEST_BASE');
 first_record;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := NULL;
 ELSIF p_navigate = 'UNIT' THEN
 IF
 test_in_utb = 'Y'
 AND test_in_utrs = 'Y'
 THEN
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := NULL;
 ELSE 
 -- set the X flag
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 IF :utrs.test_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 LOOP
 :utrs.void_cancel_flag := 'X';
 :utrs.void_cancel_id := :global.void_cancel_id;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 next_record;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF unit_extracted THEN
 show_error('2188');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 clear_block(no_validate);
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action IN ( 'VOID', 'SUPVOID' ) THEN
 go_block('UNIT_TEST_BASE');
 first_record;
 IF :unit_test_base.test_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 LOOP
 :unit_test_base.void_cancel_flag := 'X';
 :unit_test_base.void_cancel_id := :global.void_cancel_id;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 next_record;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Added for MLT 5153
 IF unit_extracted THEN
 show_error('2188');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 clear_block(no_validate);
 END IF;

 IF test_in_utrs = 'Y' THEN
 go_block('UTRS');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :system.message_level := 10;
 post;
 message(' ', no_acknowledge);
 :system.message_level := 0;
 
 -- message('block status='||:system.block_status);pause;

 go_block('CTRL_BLK_2');
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.void_reason');
 synchronize;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id');
 message('Scan Unit ID or enter M for manual entry', no_acknowledge);
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
END;

Declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 szVoidUser VARCHAR2(30);
 quote_in varchar2(5):='''';
 p_test_string varchar2(500);
 nUTRS number:=0;
 nUTB number:=0;
 connection_id EXEC_SQL.CONNTYPE;
 bIsConnected BOOLEAN;
 cursorID EXEC_SQL.CURSTYPE;
 nIgn PLS_INTEGER;
 v_cursorid integer;
 sqlstr varchar2(1500);
 nSplCount NUMBER:=0;
 
Begin
 nullchk;
 default_value(null, 'global.unit_chapter_id'); 
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action!='SUPVOID' then 
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 -- message('unit chapter id'||' '||:global.unit_chapter_id);pause;
 -- message('chapter id'||' '||:global.chapter_id);pause;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0179');
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 Else
 
 ---
 
 Begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 Exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 select count(*) into nSplCount
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 
 If nSplCount = 0 then 
 show_error('0179');
 Else
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id:= :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 End If;
 
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 End;
 ---
 
 End if;
 
 
 -- Check if the unit has the test in the UTRS or UTB tables
 
 
 
 Begin
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.group_test_id is null then
 p_test_string:=:ctrl_blk_4.test_string;
 Else
 p_test_string:='('||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.group_test_id||quote_in||')';
 End If;
 
 connection_id := EXEC_SQL.DEFAULT_CONNECTION;
 --message('11');pause;
 bIsConnected := EXEC_SQL.IS_CONNECTED;
 --message('12');pause;
 
 IF bIsConnected = FALSE THEN
 message('No primary connection. Please connect before retrying.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 cursorID := EXEC_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR;
 
 sqlstr := ' SELECT count(*) '||
 ' FROM '||' UTRS '||
 ' WHERE unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ---'|| in_quotes(p_unit_id)||
 ' AND TEST_ID in '||p_test_string||' and void_cancel_id is null' ;
 
 --message(sqlstr);pause;
 
 EXEC_SQL.PARSE(cursorID, sqlstr, exec_sql.V7);
 --message('3');pause;
 EXEC_SQL.DEFINE_COLUMN(cursorID, 1, nUTRS);
 --message('4');pause;
 nIgn := EXEC_SQL.EXECUTE_AND_FETCH(cursorID);
 --message('5');pause;
 EXEC_SQL.COLUMN_VALUE(cursorID, 1, nUTRS);
 --message('UTRS='||to_char(nUTRS));pause;
 
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursorID);
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CONNECTION;
 
 
 
 IF nUTRS = 0 then
 
 connection_id := EXEC_SQL.DEFAULT_CONNECTION;
 bIsConnected := EXEC_SQL.IS_CONNECTED; 
 cursorID := EXEC_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR;
 sqlstr := ' SELECT count(*) '||
 ' FROM '||' UNIT_TEST_BASE '||
 ' WHERE unit_id='||quote_in||:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id||quote_in|| ---'|| in_quotes(p_unit_id)||
 ' AND TEST_ID in '||p_test_string||' and void_cancel_id is null' ;
 
 --message(sqlstr);pause;
 
 EXEC_SQL.PARSE(cursorID, sqlstr, exec_sql.V7);
 -- message('3');pause;
 EXEC_SQL.DEFINE_COLUMN(cursorID, 1, nUTB);
 --message('4');pause;
 nIgn := EXEC_SQL.EXECUTE_AND_FETCH(cursorID);
 EXEC_SQL.COLUMN_VALUE(cursorID, 1, nUTB);
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursorID);
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CONNECTION;
 --message('UTB='||to_char(nUTB));pause;
 
 If nUTB = 0 then 
 show_error('0206'); --1397');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 null;
 End If;
 ELSE
 null;
 
 END IF;
 
 
 End; 
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action in ('SUPVOID','VOID') then 
 
 IF NOT unit_has_tests THEN
 show_error('0206');
 END IF;
 
 End If;
 
 IF UNIT_LABELED THEN
 show_error('9321');
 :check_flag := 'Y';
 END IF;
 
 
 -- Check if the unit was already scanned in
 If unit_check (:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id ,'I') then
 
 null;
 Else 
 show_error('1398');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 
 
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id);
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and chapter_id = nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id, chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date:=null;
 --handle_error;
 --check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('calling spot -2');pause;
 
 
 --- check if any tests is there for cancel
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action='CANCEL' then 
 cancel_validation (p_test_string);
 End if;
 
 
 
end;

 --message ('placing QCRE');pause;

-- Resetting the QC flag while voiding or cancelling a test


PROCEDURE RESET_QC_FLAG IS


 cursor void_units_cur is select distinct unit_id from utrs where void_cancel_id=:global.void_cancel_id order by unit_id;
 
 cursor void_UTRS_cur (pl_unit_id in varchar2) is select * from utrs where void_cancel_id=:global.void_cancel_id and unit_id=pl_unit_id order by unit_id, test_id;
 
 
 t_utrs_chp_id varchar2(4);
 
 cursor c1(p_batch_id in varchar2) is
 select unit_id, qc_test_flag, qc_test_date
 from units
 where batch_id = p_batch_id
 and chapter_id = t_utrs_chp_id;
 
 t_batch_id units.batch_id%type;
 t_contract_id units.contract_id%type;
 t_dummy varchar2(1);
 t_count number := 0;
 t_test_count number := 0;
 t_prev_qc_test_flag reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_flag%type;
 t_prev_qc_test_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_user reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_user%type;
 t_tb_id utrs.tb_id%type;
 t_batch_qc varchar2(1);
 t_utrs_flag varchar2(1);
 t_reset_recs_present varchar2(1);
 
 
BEGIN
 --message('Test'); pause;
 t_reset_recs_present := 'Y'; 
 

FOR Z IN void_units_cur
LOOP
 
 begin
 select chapter_id into t_utrs_chp_id from utrs where
 unit_id=Z.unit_id and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 message('cannot get UTRS chapter ID');
 check_package_failure;
 end ;
 
 begin
 select batch_id, contract_id
 into t_batch_id, t_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = Z.unit_id
 and chapter_id = t_utrs_chp_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_batch_id := null;
 t_contract_id := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 If nvl(t_contract_id, '*') != 'INTERNAL' then
 t_utrs_flag := 'N'; 
 
 
 For Z1 in void_utrs_cur (Z.unit_id)
 Loop
 
 if Z1.void_cancel_flag = 'X' then
 t_utrs_flag := 'Y'; -- Added by Kishore on 04/02/2012. IM 8062
 --message('Test ID: ' || :utrs.test_id); pause;
 -- Check whether record exists in the RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 begin
 select 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = Z1.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = Z.unit_id
 and test_id = Z1.test_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_dummy := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 -- Count the number of tests that match with the tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 if t_dummy = 'x' then
 t_count := t_count + 1;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 End loop;
 --message('Count from form: ' || t_count); pause;

 -- Do the below code only for UTRS records and not for UTB records
 if t_utrs_flag = 'Y' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/02/2012. IM 8062
 -- Count the number of tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_test_count
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = t_utrs_chp_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = Z.unit_id
 and action_flag is null;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('Count from New Table: ' || t_test_count); pause;
 
 -- If number of tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table is greater than the number of 
 -- tests marked to be voided in the form, then some tests have not been voided.
 -- So the unit has to be QC'd (QC_TEST_DATE and QC_TEST_FLAG should be left as null)
 If t_test_count > t_count then
 --message('Test1'); pause;
 null;
 Else
 --message('Test2'); pause;
 begin
 select prev_qc_test_flag, prev_qc_test_date
 into t_prev_qc_test_flag, t_prev_qc_test_date
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = t_utrs_chp_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = Z.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date = (select max(prev_qc_test_date)
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = t_utrs_chp_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = Z.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null)
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_reset_recs_present := 'N'; 
 
 --message('Record not inserted into RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 --raise form_trigger_failure; -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 -- Update only if records are present in the RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 -- Records will not be present if tests are ordered for a new unit
 if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 begin
 update units
 set qc_test_flag = t_prev_qc_test_flag,
 qc_test_date = t_prev_qc_test_date
 where unit_id = Z.unit_id;
 --and chapter_id = Z.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; -- if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then
 --message('Test3'); pause;
 End if;
 
 -- Loop through all the units in the batch to see if any of the units have to be QC'd
 --message('Test4'); pause;
 t_batch_qc := 'N';
